Zero Gravity Quirk.name: Zero Gravity Quirk
Zero Gravity Quirk.description:
🫧 You make solid people and objects weightless with your fingertip pads.

🌱 At the start you float one adult or loose rubble by touching with all five pads of one hand, up to roughly three tonnes total, and join your pads to release.
📈 With training: throws, rescue loads, tethered travel, debris attacks, awakening that spreads through touching targets and lowers them gently.
⚠️ You need pushes or tethers to steer floating solids; heavy loads and self-floating cause nausea and vomiting, and release can cause falls.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Bodily Toll, as heavy loads and self-floating upset your stomach.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Ochaco Uraraka's Zero Gravity. You are not related to her; people who know her Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Capture +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Palm Weight Release, Weightless Shoulder Throw
Zero Gravity Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: floats solid targets, people too, touched with all five pads of one hand; first-year cap about 3 tonnes at once; near-cap loads and self-floating cause nausea.
Limits: contact only (spread through touching targets is for awakening); pads together release. No steering or propulsion: needs pushes, ropes, handholds. Air and flames cannot float. Release aloft risks a dangerous fall; fast targets need a safe catch. Vomiting and exhaustion halt work.
Quirk Strain: light: small load, short throw; moderate: suspension, tethered travel, rescue hauling, rubble weapon; heavy: debris shower; severe: big falling load, repeated self-float, contact spread, mass descent.
Drawback: built in, the canon Bodily Toll.
Canon: Ochaco Uraraka's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: public combat needs a license; unlawful floating is assault; user answers for falling loads.
Look: pink fingertip pads.
